scripts.test: npm run lint:css && echo '✓ CSS lint passed' && npm run build:check && echo '✓ Build check passed'
scripts.lint:css: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const css=fs.readFileSync('app.css','utf8'); if(css.includes('undefined')||css.includes('null')){process.exit(1)} console.log('CSS syntax OK')"
scripts.build:check: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const files=['index.html','app.css','js/app.js']; files.forEach(f=>{if(!fs.existsSync(f)){console.error('Missing:'+f);process.exit(1)}}); console.log('All required files exist')"
